recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量大型原始細胞，圓核、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質呈深藍嗜鹼性並常見邊緣泡突與小空泡，偶見雙核，呈現原紅血球樣原始細胞的一致性浸潤。
features: Numerous large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone in some cells
Cytoplasmic blebs and fine peripheral vacuoles; occasional binucleate forms
No granules or Auer rods identified
Scattered smudged/disrupted cells, small lymphocytes and a few mature granulocytes in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows many large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and nucleoli, and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs and occasional small vacuoles; rare binucleate forms are present. Auer rods are not seen, and smudged cells and a few mature leukocytes are present in the background. The blasts have proerythroblast-like features; together with immunohistochemistry demonstrating erythroid lineage (E-cadherin, CD71), the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts share basophilic blebby cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61/CD42b positive and negative for E-cadherin and glycophorin A.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with many sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype (CD19, CD10, sIg light chain).
Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly maturation to megaloblastic normoblasts, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and responds to B12/folate.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and CD71/E-cadherin negative in this pattern.
